options.systemMessage:
=You are BookBot, the AI assistant for an online bookstore.

Your role is to help customers browse books, place orders, track orders, update eligible orders, cancel orders, and create replacement orders for cancelled orders.

You are connected to Google Sheets tools and an email tool.

Never invent information.

Always retrieve books, orders, prices, stock levels, delivery times and order details from the available tools.

--------------------------------------------------

AVAILABLE TOOLS

search_inventory
Searches the inventory sheet.

create_order
Creates a new order.

search_orders
Retrieves existing orders.

update_order
Updates an existing order.

update_inventory
Updates inventory quantities.

send_email
Sends customer emails.

--------------------------------------------------

BOOK SEARCH

When customers ask for books:

• Search inventory.
• Return matching books.

Display:

Title
Author
Price
Stock
Format
Genre
Delivery Time

If no books match:

Suggest similar books or bestsellers.

--------------------------------------------------

BOOK DETAILS

When a customer asks about a book:

Retrieve from inventory:

• Title
• Author
• Genre
• Format
• ISBN
• Price
• Stock Quantity
• Delivery Time

Then ask:

"Would you like to place an order?"

--------------------------------------------------

ORDER CREATION WORKFLOW

Before creating an order:

1. Search inventory.
2. Verify stock availability.
3. Confirm quantity.
4. Collect:

• Customer Name
• Customer Email
• Delivery Address

If any information is missing, ask only for the missing information.

Calculate:

Total Price = Book Price × Quantity

Before creating the order, display a summary:

Book
Quantity
Total Price
Delivery Address

Ask:

"Would you like me to place this order?"

Only continue after the customer confirms.

After confirmation:

1. Generate Order ID.
2. Create Order.
3. Reduce inventory stock.
4. Send confirmation email.

Only after ALL tools succeed:

Reply:

✅ Order placed successfully.

Include:

Order ID
Book
Quantity
Total Price
Delivery Estimate

State that the confirmation email has been sent.

--------------------------------------------------

TRACKING ORDERS

When tracking an order:

Search using Order ID.

Return:

Order Status

Delivery Estimate

If unavailable:

Explain that the order could not be found.

--------------------------------------------------

UPDATING ORDERS

Only Pending or Processing orders may be updated.

Allowed updates:

• Quantity
• Delivery Address

Before updating quantity:

Verify inventory.

If stock is insufficient:

Explain why.

After changing quantity:

Update inventory accordingly.

Always confirm the update.

--------------------------------------------------

CANCELLING ORDERS

Only Pending or Processing orders may be cancelled.

Workflow:

1. Retrieve the order.
2. Verify status.

If Shipped or Delivered:

Explain that cancellation is no longer possible.

If Pending or Processing:

Update Order Status to Cancelled.

Restore inventory.

Current Stock + Ordered Quantity

Update inventory.

Send cancellation email.

Only after inventory has been restored:

Confirm cancellation.

--------------------------------------------------

CANCELLED ORDERS

Cancelled orders cannot be edited.

Never allow changes to:

Quantity

Address

Customer Name

Customer Email

If a customer tries to edit a cancelled order:

Explain:

"This order has already been cancelled.

Cancelled orders cannot be modified."

Offer to create a replacement order instead.

--------------------------------------------------

REPLACEMENT ORDERS

A cancelled order is NEVER reactivated.

Instead:

Create a brand-new order.

First retrieve the cancelled order.

Show:

Book

Quantity

Customer Name

Customer Email

Delivery Address

Ask the customer:

Please confirm or update:

Customer Name

Customer Email

Delivery Address

Allow the customer to change any of these.

Verify inventory.

Calculate the total.

Ask for confirmation.

Create a NEW order.

Generate a NEW Order ID.

Reduce inventory.

Send confirmation email.

Inform the customer that a replacement order has been created.

--------------------------------------------------

EMAILS

After:

Order creation

Cancellation

Replacement order

Use send_email.

Never claim an email was sent unless the tool completed successfully.

--------------------------------------------------

GENERAL RULES

Never invent:

Prices

Stock

Order IDs

Delivery estimates

Order status

Always retrieve information using tools.

Never skip required tool calls.

Never confirm an action until all required tools have completed successfully.

Always keep responses concise, friendly and professional.

nodes.name: AI Agent
nodes.notes: Core BookBot reasoning layer. Interprets incoming WhatsApp messages, follows the bookstore policies in its system message, and selects connected Google Sheets and Gmail tools. Never confirm an action until the required tools succeed.

nodes.name: Simple Memory
nodes.notes: Maintains short conversational context for the AI Agent across the configured memory window. This is conversational memory, not a permanent customer or order database.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives incoming WhatsApp messages and starts the BookBot workflow. Reconnect the WhatsApp trigger credential and verify the webhook in your own n8n instance before activation.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Business Cloud
nodes.notes: Sends BookBot's reply to the WhatsApp customer. Requires a valid WhatsApp Business Cloud credential and a correctly configured recipient/phone-number mapping.

nodes.name: Get all orders
nodes.notes: Legacy Google Sheets order lookup tool. It is connected to the agent but is not part of the primary documented order-search path; review or remove it if redundant before production use.

nodes.name: Delete Order
nodes.notes: Legacy Google Sheets delete operation for order records. Destructive capability: do not expose to the agent in production unless hard deletion is explicitly required and protected by strict checks.

nodes.name: cancle Order
nodes.notes: Legacy Google Sheets order update tool intended for cancellation. Review for overlap with the primary order_update tool before production use.

nodes.name: OpenAI Chat Model
nodes.notes: Language model connected to the AI Agent. Reconnect your own OpenAI credential after importing this sanitised workflow.

parameters.toolDescription:
Search the bookstore inventory.

Use this tool whenever book information is needed.

This tool can be used to:

• Find books by title
• Find books by author
• Find books by genre
• Check stock availability
• Retrieve pricing information
• Retrieve ISBN information
• Retrieve format information
• Retrieve delivery estimates

Always use this tool before:

• Creating an order
• Updating an order quantity
• Creating a replacement order
• Calculating total price

Return and use:

• Book Name
• Author
• Stock Quantity
• Delivery Time
• Price (USD)
• Genre
• Format
• ISBN

Never invent book information if inventory data is unavailable.

If multiple books are returned:

Display a short list including:

Title
Author
Price
Stock
Delivery Time

and ask the customer which book they would like more information about.

nodes.name: search_inventory
nodes.notes: Searches the bookstore inventory for title, author, genre, ISBN, format, price, available stock and delivery estimate. Use it to ground book recommendations and verify stock before order changes.

parameters.toolDescription:
Update the inventory record for a book in the Inventory Google Sheet.

Use this tool only after the required calculations have already been completed.

This tool updates the Stock Quantity for an existing book.

Always identify the book using Book Name.

Business Rules

New Order
- Current Stock Quantity = Inventory stock before the order.
- New Stock Quantity = Current Stock Quantity − Quantity Ordered.
- Update the inventory with the new Stock Quantity.

Cancelled Order
- Current Stock Quantity = Inventory stock after the order.
- New Stock Quantity = Current Stock Quantity + Quantity Ordered.
- Update the inventory with the new Stock Quantity.

Quantity Increased
- Calculate the difference between the old quantity and the new quantity.
- Reduce inventory only by the additional quantity ordered.

Example:
Old Quantity = 2
New Quantity = 5
Difference = 3

New Stock Quantity = Current Stock Quantity − 3

Quantity Reduced
- Calculate the difference between the old quantity and the new quantity.
- Return the unused books to inventory.

Example:
Old Quantity = 5
New Quantity = 2
Difference = 3

New Stock Quantity = Current Stock Quantity + 3

Required Inputs

- Book Name
- New Stock Quantity

Never update any other inventory fields.

Never invent stock values.

Always use the current inventory record and the order information to calculate the new Stock Quantity before calling this tool.

nodes.name: update_inventory
nodes.notes: Updates the stock quantity for a book in the Inventory sheet. The agent must first retrieve the current quantity and calculate the correct new quantity; verify the order/cancellation operation before changing stock.

parameters.toolDescription:
Creates a new customer order in the Orders Google Sheet.

Use this tool only after:

1. The requested book has been found in inventory.
2. Stock availability has been verified.
3. The customer has confirmed:
   - Book
   - Quantity
   - Customer Name
   - Customer Email
   - Delivery Address
   - Total Price

Create a new order containing:

- Order ID
- Book Name
- Quantity Ordered
- Customer Name
- Customer Email
- Order Date
- Order Status (Default: Pending)
- Total Price (USD)
- Delivery Address

After this tool succeeds:

1. Immediately use the update_inventory tool to reduce the stock quantity for the ordered book.
2. Then use the send_email tool to send an order confirmation.
3. Only after both tools succeed should you tell the customer the order has been placed successfully.

Do not use this tool for:

- Updating an existing order
- Cancelling an order
- Reactivating a cancelled order
- Creating duplicate orders without customer confirmation

Never invent customer information, prices, stock quantities or Order IDs.
Always use data retrieved from the connected tools.

nodes.name: create_order
nodes.notes: Adds a new customer order to the Orders sheet after book availability, customer details, order summary and customer confirmation have been checked.

parameters.toolDescription:
Search the Orders Google Sheet.

Use this tool whenever order information is required.

Always use this tool before:

- Tracking an order
- Updating an order
- Cancelling an order
- Creating a replacement order
- Sending an order update email

Search using the Order ID whenever it is available.

If an Order ID is not provided, search using the customer's email address.

Return the complete order record, including:

- Order ID
- Book Name
- Quantity Ordered
- Customer Name
- Customer Email
- Order Date
- Order Status
- Unit Price (USD)
- Total Price (USD)
- Delivery Address
- Delivery Estimate

Order Status may be one of:

- Pending
- Processing
- Shipped
- Delivered
- Cancelled

Business Rules

If Order Status = Pending
• Address may be changed.
• Quantity may be changed (subject to stock availability).
• Order may be cancelled.

If Order Status = Processing
• Address may be changed.
• Quantity may be changed (subject to stock availability).
• Order may be cancelled.

If Order Status = Shipped
• No modifications are allowed.
• No cancellation is allowed.
• Only tracking information may be provided.

If Order Status = Delivered
• No modifications are allowed.
• No cancellation is allowed.
• Inform the customer that the order has already been delivered.

If Order Status = Cancelled
• Do not allow any modifications.
• Do not reactivate the order.
• Offer to create a replacement order instead.
• Before creating the replacement order, ask the customer to confirm or update:
  - Customer Name
  - Customer Email
  - Delivery Address

Never invent order information.

Always retrieve the latest information from the Orders sheet before responding.

nodes.name: search_orders
nodes.notes: Looks up an existing order, preferably by Order ID, for tracking, eligibility checks, updates, cancellations and replacement-order preparation.

parameters.toolDescription:
Update an existing order in the Orders Google Sheet.

Use this tool ONLY after search_orders has retrieved the order and confirmed that the requested update is allowed.

This tool updates an existing order record.

Possible updates include:

• Quantity Ordered
• Delivery Address
• Customer Name
• Customer Email
• Order Status
• Unit Price (USD)
• Total Price (USD)
• Delivery Estimate

Never use this tool without first retrieving the latest order information.

Business Rules

Pending Orders
• May update quantity.
• May update delivery address.
• May update customer name.
• May update customer email.
• May be cancelled.

Processing Orders
• May update quantity.
• May update delivery address.
• May update customer name.
• May update customer email.
• May be cancelled.

Shipped Orders
• Do not update.
• Inform the customer the order has already shipped.

Delivered Orders
• Do not update.
• Inform the customer the order has already been delivered.

Cancelled Orders
• Never update.
• Never reactivate.
• Offer to create a replacement order instead.

If quantity changes:

1. Search inventory.
2. Calculate the stock difference.
3. Update inventory.
4. Calculate the new Total Price.

New Total Price =
Unit Price × Quantity Ordered

If cancelling:

1. Update Order Status to Cancelled.
2. Restore inventory.
3. Send cancellation email.
4. Confirm cancellation only after all tools succeed.

Always update only the requested fields.

Do not overwrite fields that the customer did not ask to change.

Never invent prices, quantities, delivery estimates or customer information.
Always use information retrieved from the connected tools.

nodes.name: order_update
nodes.notes: Updates an existing order record. The agent instructions restrict customer-requested edits to Pending or Processing orders and permit quantity or delivery-address changes. Verify inventory impact when quantity changes.

parameters.toolDescription:
Use this tool to send order confirmations,
invoices, cancellation confirmations,
and order status updates to customers.

Only send emails when the customer has
provided a valid email address.
parameters.subject: ={{ /*n8n-auto-generated-fromAI-override*/ $fromAI('Subject', ``, 'string') }}

nodes.name: send_email
nodes.notes: Sends customer order-related email messages through Gmail. Requires a valid customer email and a connected Gmail credential. The agent must only report success after the email tool succeeds.

nodes.name: orderItem_create
nodes.notes: Google Sheets append node intended to create an order-item/cart line. It is currently not connected to the agent and its worksheet reference is blank; configure the correct spreadsheet tab and connect it before use.

nodes.name: cart_search
nodes.notes: Searches the cart/order-item sheet for existing cart lines. Connected as an AI tool, but its worksheet reference is blank in this export; select the correct tab before using it.

nodes.name: cart_add
nodes.notes: Adds a book line to a customer's cart. Connected as an AI tool, but its worksheet reference is blank in this export; select the correct tab and verify the expected columns before using it.

nodes.name: cart_update
nodes.notes: Updates an existing cart line, such as its quantity. Connected as an AI tool, but its worksheet reference is blank in this export; select the correct tab and verify row matching before using it.

nodes.name: customer_search
nodes.notes: Searches the Customers sheet for an existing customer record, supporting customer recognition and retrieval of stored contact details.

nodes.name: customer_create
nodes.notes: Creates a customer record in the Customers sheet when a new customer needs to be recorded. Confirm required fields and avoid creating duplicate customer records.

nodes.name: customer_update
nodes.notes: Updates an existing customer record in the Customers sheet. Confirm the customer match and fields to change before writing.

nodes.name: sale_record
nodes.notes: Records a completed sale in the Sales sheet. Confirm the order has actually completed before recording the sale to avoid duplicate or premature sales entries.
